provisions.title: Notice by Data Fiduciary
provisions.summary: Notice is understandable on its own, itemises the personal data and purposes, and links to withdrawal, rights and complaint channels.

provisions.title: Consent Managers
provisions.summary: Registration and obligations of Consent Managers.

provisions.title: Reasonable security safeguards
provisions.summary: Minimum safeguards including encryption/obfuscation, access control, logging and monitoring, backups, and contractual safeguards with processors.

provisions.title: Personal data breach intimation
provisions.summary: Inform affected Data Principals without delay and the Board, with a detailed report within the prescribed time.

provisions.title: Retention and erasure
provisions.summary: Time limits for erasure for specified classes, advance notice before erasure, and minimum retention of related logs.

provisions.title: Contact information
provisions.summary: Prominently publish contact information of the DPO or responsible person.

provisions.title: Verifiable consent for children
provisions.summary: Due diligence to verify that the person giving consent for a child is an identifiable adult parent.

provisions.title: Additional obligations of SDFs
provisions.summary: Annual DPIA and audit, with significant observations reported to the Board.

provisions.title: Rights of Data Principals
provisions.summary: Publish how rights can be exercised and the identifiers needed; respond within prescribed periods.

provisions.title: Transfer outside India
provisions.summary: Conditions on making personal data available outside India.
